purpose: Portable answer format for any AI using the Davidson retrieval packet.

required_fields.answer: A concise synthesis grounded in the returned source passages
required_fields.source_quotations: An array of quotation candidates actually used in the answer
required_fields.references: An array of matching human-readable references

citation_rule: Use the printed textbook page as p. and cite material factual statements with the matching quotation and reference.
page_rule: page_number is the printed book page; pdf_page is retained only for physical-file navigation.
summary_rule: Summaries provide context only. Source quotations and source passages are the evidence.
visual_rule: Reference tables, figures, charts, and illustrations by name, chapter, and printed page. Use full reconstructed contents only for tables.
verification_rule: Keep status generated_not_verified until the cited source page image has been manually checked.
